description: This Java class 'EmailUtils' provides utility methods for constructing email-related data, including creating a map of email template tokens with store information, localization, and optional store logo inclusion.

classes.name: EmailUtils
classes.description: A utility class for constructing email data for templates, including store information and logo embedding.

methods.name: createEmailObjectsMap
methods.description: Creates a map of email template tokens, incorporating store info, localization messages, and optionally a store logo image URL.
